loop: CANDIDATE -> TECHNICAL DIAGNOSIS (limiting variable + direction) -> TECHNICAL MUTATION (actual design variable) -> INDEPENDENT TECHNICAL EVALUATION -> EVIDENCE/PRIOR-ART RECHECK -> KEEP/KILL -> SECOND IMPROVEMENT

MAX_ITERATIONS_DEFAULT.justification: the CEO milestone is DIAGNOSE -> TECHNICAL MUTATION -> RE-EVALUATE -> SECOND IMPROVEMENT; two iterations demonstrate repeatability at bounded cost

MAX_PROPOSALS_PER_ITERATION.justification: bounded proposal budget, identical to the R378 epistemic loop: three attempts, then the honest no-defensible-mutation verdict

VALUE_CLASS_STRICTNESS.justification: EXTRACTED claims are span-verified or rejected (Art. II/VI); MODELLED values are admitted only when declared; an unbounded parameter is immutable (ADR_R379 anti-gaming)

mutation_kinds_reserved.ARCHITECTURE_CHANGE: needs a structural/control search space at a higher fidelity tier (ADR_R379)
mutation_kinds_reserved.CONTROL_POLICY_CHANGE: needs a structural/control search space at a higher fidelity tier (ADR_R379)

keep_criterion: the child's OWN independent technical evaluation must confirm the objective improves in the mutation direction with constraints preserved — a score increase is NEVER sufficient (CEO R379 item 4/8)
outcome_reason: the candidate's own custodied evidence yields no quantifiable technical objective+leverage (admitted: {"parameters": 8, "parameters_with_value": 0, "parameters_extracted": 0, "parameters_modelled": 0, "parameters_with_envelope": 0, "constraints": 0, "objectives": 3, "dependencies": 3, "objects": 2, "failure_modes": 3}); the technical layer cannot engage — an honest measured gap (the 🟡 state), not a kill and not a failure

objects.name: Smart Battery Management System
objects.role: Battery safety monitoring and protection circuit

parameters.name: Overcharge protection threshold
parameters.role: Prevents battery from charging beyond safe voltage limit

parameters.name: Temperature monitoring threshold
parameters.role: Detects abnormal temperature conditions that could lead to thermal runaway

parameters.name: Current limiting threshold
parameters.role: Restricts current flow to prevent dangerous charging conditions

parameters.name: Energy density
parameters.role: Energy storage capacity per unit mass of battery

parameters.name: Dendrite formation rate
parameters.role: Rate of lithium dendrite growth which can cause internal short circuits

parameters.name: Thermal propagation speed
parameters.role: Rate at which temperature spreads between battery cells

parameters.name: Cycle stability
parameters.role: Number of charge/discharge cycles before significant capacity degradation

parameters.name: Sensor response time
parameters.role: Time taken for sensors to detect abnormal conditions and trigger protection

constraints.justification: Must meet consumer product cost targets for retrofitting at pack or circuit level
Must be retrofittable to existing consumer lithium-ion battery packs
Temperature monitoring must detect abnormal conditions before thermal runaway occurs

objectives.basis: Prevent thermal runaway by detecting abnormal temperature conditions that could lead to battery fire initiation
Prevent battery fire initiation by stopping charging beyond safe voltage limits during overcharge scenarios
Prevent battery fire by limiting dangerous current flows from cheap chargers or malfunctioning charging equipment

failure_modes.name: Thermal runaway
failure_modes.problem_link: Battery fire initiation in consumer products due to excessive temperature

failure_modes.name: Overcharge failure
failure_modes.problem_link: Battery fire initiation in consumer products due to charging beyond safe voltage limits

failure_modes.name: Current spike
failure_modes.problem_link: Battery fire initiation in consumer products due to excessive current flow from chargers

dependencies.statement: Early temperature detection by sensors decreases the rate of thermal propagation between battery cells
Voltage limiting decreases the rate of lithium dendrite formation which can cause internal short circuits
Current limiting decreases the likelihood of thermal runaway by preventing excessive heat generation
Faster sensor response time decreases the rate of thermal propagation by enabling quicker intervention

objective.basis: Prevent thermal runaway by detecting abnormal temperature conditions that could lead to battery fire initiation

uncertainty.note: UNKNOWN values are never treated as zeros; unverifiable constraints are never treated as satisfied (Art. XXV / Art. IV)

conventions.name: ORDINAL_LEVERAGE_BY_PATH_LENGTH
conventions.justification: with MONOTONE-only relations the evaluator cannot rank leverage by magnitude; it ranks by (1) fewest constraint blocks, (2) shortest causal path from the parameter to the objective target, (3) envelope provenance class (EXTRACTED beats MODELLED). This is a declared ordinal convention, not a measurement — recorded on every evaluation that uses it.
conventions.uncertainty: ordinal only; magnitudes are UNKNOWN at this tier

conventions.name: DIRECTIONAL_FAIL_CLOSED
conventions.justification: a proposed change is constraint-BLOCKED when (a) the changed parameter's own numeric constraint would be violated at the proposed value, or (b) a relation-connected constraint target is already VIOLATED or value-UNKNOWN and the predicted direction moves it TOWARD its bound. Fail-closed on directional risk: an unknown-position target moving toward a bound is a blocked move, not an accepted one (Art. IV).

fidelity_escalation.note: higher tiers (NUMERICAL_SOLVER / SIMULATION / NEURAL_OPERATOR) are contract-reserved and not registered; escalation is recorded, never faked at the current tier
